title: Accept a team invitation
summary: Join the correct business using the email address named in your invitation.

sections.title: Join the business
sections.body:
1. Open your secure ClipperDesk invitation. Check the business name, role, listed locations and expiry.
2. If you already have an account for the invited email, select **Sign in to accept**. You return to the invitation after signing in.
3. If you are already signed in with the matching email, select **Join** followed by the business name.
4. If you need a new account, enter **Your name**, **Create password** and **Confirm password**. Read and accept the linked terms and privacy information, then select **Create account and join** followed by the business name.

sections.title: Signed in with a different email
sections.body: Use **Sign out**, then sign in as the address shown on the invitation. An invitation cannot be accepted by a different account. Ask the manager to correct the invite if they used the wrong address.

sections.title: After joining
sections.body: Your access follows the workspace role and locations chosen by the business. Missing pages do not mean the invitation failed: the owner controls which tools you can use. Your manager separately manages your working profile, services and hours.

sections.title: Expired or cancelled invitations
sections.body: Ask the business owner or team manager to send a new secure invitation. Creating a separate owner workspace will not restore access to their business.
